calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Arlettie
calls.summary: Arleti aims to enhance website form performance and conversion rates through AB testing due to unclear issues impacting these areas. Axel Guillaume noted that leadership has tasked the team with implementing AB testing but did not clarify specific objectives. GrowthBook, an open-source AB testing platform, was discussed, highlighting its free core version and US$40 per user per month professional tier, making it suitable for small teams. Key features include support for feature flagging, user experiments, and a no-code visual editor, which together facilitate quick testing. Axel plans to trial GrowthBook on their website, starting with the free version before deciding on a purchase. Documentation, case studies, and potential technical support were also mentioned to assist in the evaluation process.
calls.keywords: AB testing, feature flagging, open source, GrowthBook, conversion optimization, dashboard demo
